title: 생활 속 소리 말: 무슨 소리가 나요?
objective: By the end, you can read 10 everyday Korean sound words in short notices and messages and say what sound they show and what is happening.
summary: Learners read common Korean sound words (onomatopoeia) in notices, messages, and daily talk and work out what is happening.
note: You will see these sound words in everyday talk, text messages, food ads, and apartment notices.

task.title: Read and find the sound
task.line: Read each Korean sentence or text, then choose, write, or explain the sound word.

items.text: Heavy steps or hits that happen again and again.
One loud, strong hit, like a door slamming.
Knocking on a door. It can also mean water dripping.
The sound of a doorbell or a buzzer.
Soup or water bubbling as it boils.
Meat or oil sizzling in a hot pan.
Your stomach making noise when you are hungry.
A buzzing insect or a running machine, like a fan.

sections.heading: How to read sound words
paragraphs: One sound vs. many: a single word like 쾅 usually means it happened once. A doubled word like 쿵쿵 or 콜록콜록 means it happened again and again.
Sound words often come right before the verb (문이 쾅 닫혔어요), before 소리가 나다 (꼬르륵 소리가 났어요), or with -거리다 to make a verb (윙윙거리다 = to keep buzzing).

sections.heading: Different from English
paragraphs: Korean adults use sound words a lot. You will see them in news, food ads, webtoons, apartment notices, and texts with friends. Don't think of them as baby talk.
Some sounds are close to English (딩동 = ding-dong), but many are not (똑똑 = knock knock, 콜록콜록 = cough cough). Learn each one as a word, and don't try to guess it from English.

exercises: Read the apartment notice and answer in English. Which two noises are the problem, and after what time should people be careful?: 「밤늦게 아이들이 뛰는 쿵쿵 소리와 문을 쾅 닫는 소리 때문에 아래층 주민이 힘들어합니다. 밤 10시 이후에는 조심해 주세요.」
Choose the right sound word: ① 라면 물이 (보글보글 / 지글지글) 끓어요. ② 프라이팬에서 계란이 (보글보글 / 지글지글) 익어요.
Write the sound word from this sheet that you hear in each situation: ① 누가 현관 벨을 눌렀어요. ② 접시를 바닥에 떨어뜨려서 깨졌어요. ③ 감기에 걸린 친구가 기침을 해요.
Fill in the blank with one sound word from this sheet: ① 아침을 굶었더니 수업 중에 배에서 ____ 소리가 났어요. ② 여름밤에 모기가 귀 옆에서 ____거려서 잠이 깼어요.
Read the messages and answer in English. What did Minsu do, and why didn't Jisu answer?: 민수: 아까 네 방 문을 똑똑 두드렸는데 대답이 없더라. / 지수: 미안, 이어폰을 끼고 있었어.
answers: Children running (쿵쿵, heavy footsteps) and doors slamming (쾅); after 10 p.m.
① 딩동 ② 쨍그랑 ③ 콜록콜록
He knocked on her door (똑똑). She was wearing earphones, so she didn't hear it.
